legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 says an unmarked root is legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE and must not be rewritten.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: Supergoal step 1 rejects any trailing planning-mode value other than upfront or incremental before any scratch or vault write, while superauthor A1 forbids code execution.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: Supergoal step 4 requires every newly authored incremental root to persist the exact Planning mode marker incremental.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent filenames with a stated preparation method, but S3 requires a current PREPARED receipt before execution.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 forbids deferring architecture or other foundational choices without a bounded discovery contract and classifies unbounded foundational uncertainty as invalid.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires the provider PR merged into authoritative main plus tracked delivery evidence, so an open PR neither satisfies S02 nor permits C9 completion.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 and supertraverse C9 say a provider disposition closes only its own obligation and cannot satisfy a live consumer until an adopted replan removes or replaces the contract.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 classifies a dependency cycle in the active upfront graph as BLOCKED before selection.

unlinked_active_row.reason: Superstage S2 requires every active scope row to have a readable Plan link and supertraverse C6 forbids filling an upfront publication gap through incremental authoring.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: Superstage S1/S2 allow the mapped scratch tree to pass candidate validation with three unique leaves, but candidate state and Preparation none cannot authorize execution under S1/S3.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: Supergoal steps 6-7 preserve an interrupted reviewed upfront tree in its scratch index as DRAFT-INCOMPLETE until confirmation, with no vault publication or execution.

resume_identical_source.reason: Supergoal's resume contract reuses the matching scratch set, destination, and stable IDs without allocating duplicates, but re-applies the still-unsatisfied confirmation gate.

resume_changed_source.reason: Supergoal's resume contract requires an explicitly revised scratch draft when the source digest changes and otherwise preserves the old draft as DRAFT-INCOMPLETE without execution.

confirmation_refused.reason: Supergoal step 7 says a declined human gate preserves the scratch index, reports DRAFT-INCOMPLETE, and performs no vault write or code execution.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: Supermeta step 6 preserves and reports an explicit DRAFT-INCOMPLETE index, writes nothing to the iteration ledger, and exits absent verified complete publication evidence.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns bounded file, helper, and test-detail changes that preserve every commitment to refine under PLAN_REFINER.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 assigns an unavoidable shared-contract behavior change affecting consumers to structural replan under REPLANNER.

preparation_noop.reason: Superstage S5 classifies first receipt attachment with no plan-body change as amendment none and keeps the Stage revision unchanged.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: Superstage S4/S5 permits evidence-grounded bounded executable detail changes as a content amendment, preserving commitments while incrementing the Stage revision.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: Superrefine and superstage S4 require REPLAN-REQUIRED when evidence expands approved scope, preserving the approved leaf rather than overwriting it in place.

source_revision_changed.reason: Superstage S4/S5 treats a changed authoritative acceptance condition and source-revision mismatch as REPLAN-REQUIRED, invalidating executability without an in-place rewrite.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: Superstage S5 requires a focused compatible-baseline revalidation receipt for an unrelated HEAD advance while preserving both commitments and Stage revision.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: Superstage S4/S5 classifies a consumed contract's behavioral semantic-revision change as REPLAN-REQUIRED, so the old consumer is non-executable and cannot be overwritten in place.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: Supertraverse C6 and superrun step 1 return NEEDS-REFINEMENT for the first eligible upfront leaf missing a preparation receipt and prohibit EXECUTOR from running code.

partially_executed_stage.reason: Superstage S3 and superrefine's entry gate route an already-started stage through execution or CI recovery and forbid in-place preparation over its task history.

manual_superrun_pending_batch.reason: Superstage S1 makes Active replan a durable execution barrier, so superrun must return BLOCKED before implementation or merge despite the older preparation.

execution_snapshot_historical_digest.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 and supertraverse C7 require the execution-entry snapshot and verify H2 against the historical V4 prepared-plan blob rather than the closeout-annotated current file.

merged_lost_closeout_response.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 reuses one authoritative matching delivery receipt and linked tree history after a lost response, avoiding duplicate publication or code execution.

ci_pending_replan_request.reason: Superagent's CI resume reconciliation and superloop L6 require the committed pending batch to pause the whole goal, preserve PR evidence, and return to WAITING FOR PLAN without merging green CI.

impact_local_s02_detail.reason: Superstage S4 keeps a purely internal S02 detail change under PLAN_REFINER and says such a change creates no structural batch or whole-goal barrier.

impact_absorbed_at_s03.reason: Superstage S4 revises S02 and S03, stops propagation at S03's preserved C-S03@2 output, retains unaffected unfinished S04 and S05, and preserves delivered S01 as completed history.

impact_foundational_change.reason: Superstage S4 expands beyond the initial dependent closure when shared foundational evidence invalidates S04 too, revises every unfinished stage, and keeps delivered S01 as completed history with no preserved boundary.

replan_before_request_commit.reason: Supertraverse C8 requires the tracked decision record and root Active replan pointer to be committed together before REPLANNER dispatch, while a loop-log-only adoption keeps execution paused.

replan_after_request_commit.reason: Supertraverse C8 says an authoritative pending request with no unique draft continues by dispatching superreplan while its whole-goal execution barrier remains active.

replan_drafting_interrupted.reason: Supertraverse C8 resumes one unique Decision-ID-bound scratch batch as a draft while the pending Active replan barrier keeps execution paused and no vault publication exists.

replan_published_before_loop_update.reason: Supertraverse C8 says a uniquely verified published generation overrides stale PLANNING and old-generation hints and must be resumed without republishing.

late_predecessor_closeout.reason: Supertraverse C8 treats a late predecessor closeout as historical evidence and forbids changing the active successor row or closing the successor by inference.

replan_stale_baseline.reason: Superreplan reconciliation requires relevant source and vault-path drift to be reassessed and recorded before publication while the active replan barrier remains in force.

replan_duplicate_decision.reason: Superreplan and supertraverse C8 classify duplicate live records claiming one Decision ID with divergent candidate closures as BLOCKED rather than as a publication.

replan_missing_record.reason: Superstage S1 and superreplan require the Active replan record to be readable and tracked, so the missing referenced record blocks dispatch and leaves the barrier active.

replan_divergent_successors.reason: Supertraverse C8 makes multiple unretired divergent successor sets BLOCKED, gives them no resumable publication form, and keeps execution paused behind the pending record.

replan_partial_pr_reuse.reason: Superstage S4 permits verified resume-existing reuse only with preserved predecessor evidence, remaining tasks, and repeated review and tests, while replanning never closes the old PR and the revised successor still needs refinement.

replan_split_merge_mapping.reason: Superstage S2 and S4 allow a total split or merge mapping to fresh IDs with all consumers rewired, but an unpublished candidate without current preparation receipts is not executable.

replan_retained_preparation.reason: Superstage S4 and S5 preserve retained-stage readiness across a generation only through a focused new-generation revalidation proving the stage and all relevant evidence unchanged.

replan_revised_preparation.reason: Superstage S4 and S5 require every revised stage to receive a new preparation receipt for the published generation because an old-generation receipt is only history.

replan_atomicity_violation.reason: Superreplan requires one complete atomic publication and says dirty active-link edits are neither authoritative nor executable while the committed pending barrier remains active.

replan_internal_pr_not_merged.reason: Supertraverse C8 says an open unmerged internal docs PR is only a candidate with publication none, while authoritative main retains the pending non-executable generation.

legacy_single_leaf_repair.reason: Superreplan's incremental wrapper and supertraverse C8 route an adopted legacy repair to REPLANNER while preserving the single-leaf shape and creating no upfront batch.

discovery_completion_without_code_pr.reason: Supertraverse C9 accepts no-code discovery completion when the required evidence, decision, and delivered discovery contract are verified on the authoritative vault branch.

discovery_execution_entry_without_code_c.reason: Superrun's evidence-only discovery branch skips the code worktree, SDD, and code PR path and requires authoritative A7 publication of the reviewed evidence and decision.

partial_closeout_open_pr.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 allows an identity-bound partial closeout for a verified open PR but marks it undelivered, non-consumable, and executed with the PR still open.

discovery_barrier_after_experiment.reason: Superrun's discovery authority gate preserves reviewed scratch evidence as a checkpoint and returns to C8 with execution paused when a pending Active replan appears before A7 publication.

mapped_successor_ci_redirect.reason: Superagent's CI reconciliation redirects a mapped resume-existing successor through normal prepared-stage execution with a new successor snapshot and fresh tasks, reviews, and tests, so the old green packet cannot authorize merge.

partial_closeout_upgrade_after_merge.reason: Superfinish's stable execution-attempt key requires later verified head, CI, and merge observations for the same PR to upgrade the existing report in place without duplicate publication.

routine_closeout_finding.reason: Superfinish finding classification says a verified local implementation fact that preserves commitments and downstream evidence creates no replan and leaves current preparation valid.

contract_contradiction_finding.reason: Superfinish and superstage S4 say a verified shared-contract contradiction requires the decision and replan path, invalidates affected unfinished preparation, and prevents execution.

stale_completed_ancestor_unsatisfied_dep.reason: Supertraverse C9 descends through stale closed ancestors and returns BLOCKED when a live consumer depends on a declined provider whose contract was never delivered or rewired.

supervisor_native_refinement.reason: Superagent WAITING FOR PLAN selects PLAN_REFINER for the first eligible upfront stage needing preparation, resolves each pin by process environment then repo then default, and enters PLANNING for one dispatch.

supervisor_cursor_native_refinement.reason: Superagent's Cursor rule uses the generated named definition for a native non-inherit model, treats unsupported native effort as inherit for definition selection, and dispatches the selected refinement once from PLANNING.

supervisor_bridged_refinement.reason: Superagent selects PLAN_REFINER for the first eligible unprepared stage and, with the configured Pi bridge route available, resolves both pins from repo .superenv and authorizes one PLANNING dispatch.

supervisor_prepared_target.reason: Superagent WAITING FOR PLAN moves a valid prepared upfront target directly to WAITING FOR RUN with EXECUTOR pins and zero planning dispatches, without checking an unused refiner definition.

supervisor_adopted_legacy_repair.reason: Superagent gives a reconciled adopted legacy C8 repair priority over ordinary descent and selects superreplan under the independently pinned REPLANNER role.

supervisor_adopted_batch_repair.reason: Superagent selects REPLANNER for a committed pending upfront batch, resolves the model from repo .superenv and effort from the process environment, and enters PLANNING for one dispatch.

supervisor_stale_hints.reason: Superagent crash recovery resets persisted PLANNING, lets authoritative C8 artifacts override stale refinement hints, and selects the committed batch for one REPLANNER dispatch.

supervisor_post_leaf_refinement.reason: Superagent re-enters WAITING FOR PLAN after a verified leaf result and selects PLAN_REFINER for the next eligible stage lacking preparation, using harness-default pins for one dispatch.

supervisor_execution_replan_required.reason: Superagent gives REPLAN-REQUIRED result evidence priority and, after the decision ladder cannot adopt authority, parks in WAITING FOR INPUT with no authorized role, target, or additional heavy dispatch.

supervisor_legacy_incremental_planning.reason: Superstage S1 resolves an unmarked root as legacy incremental regardless of the environment, so superagent selects ordinary superplan under PLANNER for P1.

supervisor_missing_native_definition.reason: Superagent's selected-role-only preflight requires the native Claude definition for a fully pinned PLAN_REFINER and on absence keeps WAITING FOR PLAN with zero dispatches before the decision ladder.

supervisor_missing_bridge_cli.reason: Superagent's selected-role-only preflight requires the configured foreign CLI for bridged REPLANNER and on absence keeps WAITING FOR PLAN with zero dispatches before the decision ladder.
